definitions.gloss: three-day weekend; three consecutive days off
definitions.explanation: Three consecutive holidays, typically formed when a national holiday falls on a Monday or Friday, creating a long weekend. Japan's Happy Monday system creates several three-day weekends per year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三連休|さんれんきゅう}だ。
examples.english: Next week there's a three-day weekend.

examples.japanese: {三連休|さんれんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip taking advantage of the three-day weekend.

examples.japanese: {三連休|さんれんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最終日|さいしゅうび}→最終日：24777_saishuubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: The expressways get congested on the last day of a three-day weekend, so it's better to leave early.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three) + ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧ (consecutive holidays). Japan has several three-day weekends per year thanks to the Happy Monday system, which moved some national holidays to Mondays. The pattern extends to other numbers: {四連休|よんれんきゅう}, {五連休|ごれんきゅう}, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三連休|さんれんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧ (taking advantage of the three-day weekend)
- {三連休|さんれんきゅう}⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧ (the first day of a three-day weekend)
- {三連休|さんれんきゅう}⟦{最終日|さいしゅうび}→最終日：24777_saishuubi⟧ (the last day of a three-day weekend)
